en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a street scene in a small European town. Lined with two- and three-story houses with gabled roofs and dormer windows, the broad street has small trees along the sidewalks and several pedestrians walking in the middle. At the top center, printed text reads "Bad Sulza — Obermarkt" indicating that the view depicts the Obermarkt (upper market) area of Bad Sulza.
